title: 6. Phase 4 — Post-Incident Activity
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L20: Incident Response: 6. Phase 4 — Post-Incident Activity.

blocks.text: The phase most often skipped — and the most valuable.

items: Held within 2 weeks of incident closure (memory is fresh; calendars haven't moved on)
Attendees: full IR team + management + affected business units
Blame-free format — focus on system failures, not individual mistakes

blocks.text: Reconstruct what happened minute by minute:

`` 2026-04-15 02:14 Initial access via phishing email 2026-04-15 02:32 Macro execution drops payload 2026-04-15 03:18 Lateral movement to file server via SMB 2026-04-15 09:42 SOC alert: unusual SMB write pattern 2026-04-15 09:51 Analyst confirms incident, escalates to IR Lead 2026-04-15 10:05 Containment: isolate file server ... ``

items: Executive summary (1 page) — what happened, impact, what we did
Root cause — why did this happen?
IOCs discovered — for sharing with industry/regulators
Recommendations — concrete control improvements with owners and dates

blocks.text: Every incident reveals a gap. Update playbooks immediately so the next analyst benefits from your pain.
